title: NASA sent 3,301 bees into space in 1984 to study honeycomb without gravity
description: In a groundbreaking 1984 mission aboard NASA's Space Shuttle Discovery, thousands of honeybees ventured into space. They showcased remarkable adaptability by constructing around 200 cm of honeycomb in microgravity. Researchers noted variations in the size and structure of the cells, diverging from typical Earth patterns. This experiment sought to unravel how bees organize in the absence of gravity, revealing that behavior is crucial for their collaboration.
